endRelationship.description: The relationship ends. Stamps relationshipEndedAt, from which the client's retention term counts.

actions.description: Stamp relationshipEndedAt with the moment the relationship ended; the retention term counts from it.

reactivate.description: The client comes back. Clears relationshipEndedAt, which takes the client off the destruction schedule.

actions.description: Clear relationshipEndedAt; a client that comes back has no destruction date.

block.description: Block the account. Blocking neither ends a relationship nor revives one, so relationshipEndedAt is left as it is.

contactsUid.title: Contacts UID
contactsUid.description: REQUIRED foreign key to the Nextcloud addressbook contact that is the authoritative identity for this client. Resolved/created via ContactVcardService; never minted locally.

name.title: Name
name.description: Denormalised read-only mirror of the NC contact name (vCard FN). The Nextcloud Contact is authoritative; refreshed on every sync by ContactVcardService. Edit identity in the addressbook.

email.title: Email
email.description: Denormalised read-only mirror of the NC contact email (vCard EMAIL). The Nextcloud Contact is authoritative.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Denormalised read-only mirror of the NC contact phone (vCard TEL). The Nextcloud Contact is authoritative.

address.title: Address
address.description: Denormalised read-only mirror of the NC contact postal address. The Nextcloud Contact is authoritative.

website.title: Website
website.description: Denormalised read-only mirror of the NC contact website (vCard URL). The Nextcloud Contact is authoritative.

lifecycleStage.title: Lifecycle stage
lifecycleStage.description: CRM relationship lifecycle stage of this account.

segment.title: Segment
segment.description: Account segment / tier for sales prioritisation (e.g. SMB, enterprise, public-sector).

accountOwner.title: Account owner
accountOwner.description: Nextcloud user UID of the account owner / responsible sales agent.

accountStatus.title: Account status
accountStatus.description: Lifecycle status of the CRM relationship/account record (distinct from the contact identity).

relationshipEndedAt.title: Relationship ended
relationshipEndedAt.description: When the account status last moved to inactive. Set by the account status lifecycle and cleared when the client becomes active again; the client's retention term counts from it.

contactsUid.title: Contacts UID
contactsUid.description: REQUIRED foreign key to the Nextcloud addressbook contact that is the authoritative identity for this contact person. Resolved/created via ContactVcardService; never minted locally.

name.title: Name
name.description: Denormalised read-only mirror of the NC contact name (vCard FN). The Nextcloud Contact is authoritative; refreshed on every sync by ContactVcardService. Edit identity in the addressbook.

email.title: Email
email.description: Denormalised read-only mirror of the NC contact email (vCard EMAIL). The Nextcloud Contact is authoritative.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Denormalised read-only mirror of the NC contact phone (vCard TEL). The Nextcloud Contact is authoritative.

contactsUid.title: Contacts UID
contactsUid.description: Canonical foreign key to the Nextcloud addressbook contact (vCard UID) that this interaction was with: the party of the contact moment. Set by the migration from the linked client's contactsUid and on new interactions from the chosen party. Works for any addressbook party (client account or contact person).
